About.title: An online learning platform specialized in remote Quran education
About.description: Motqen Quran Academy was launched to make learning the Quran easier for Muslim men and women everywhere, through a modern online platform that combines religious discipline with flexibility in learning, supervised by a select group of teachers licensed with a connected chain of transmission, in a safe and motivating educational environment suited to all ages and levels.
About.imageAlt: A teacher giving a remote memorization session via computer
About.visionDesc: To be the world's leading platform in Quran education for Muslims everywhere.
About.missionDesc: Spreading and teaching the Quran with mastery and ease for all Muslims through a trusted educational platform.
About.valuesDesc: Sincerity, mastery, trustworthiness, and professionalism in every session we provide.
